friendly_name: troupe configuration: lineage for every change
purpose_context: Configuration is changed by people and AI agents through the CLI, by hand edits, and by the first import. This mission adds an auditable lineage to every history event — actor, channel, UTC time, optional reason, and a change id shared by everything one command produces — and states 'unknown' explicitly where the author cannot be known.
purpose_tldr: Record who changed each setting, how, when, why, and which other changes came with it, readable through 'troupe config history'.
